observations: Subtracting the target header origin 3f20h from the header file location gives the same d4a0h code base independently used to resolve the INT 21h dispatch table.
The header relative jump, interpreted in that segment, lands at file 199bfh, which begins with CLI and CLD and matches the DOS initialization entry.
The BIOS initialization sequence reads word offset 3 from the current DOS image, stores it, shifts it by four and subtracts it from the DOS segment.
The corresponding historical BIOS source describes offset 3 as the DOS origin and adjusts the DOS segment in the same manner.
limitations: The code-base calculation relies on the target image having the established uncompressed resident-code mapping.
This establishes the header field role more strongly but does not prove the 6.x formula for deriving it remains in use.
Full BIOS and kernel linkage remain unverified.
